name: ca-study
description: Evidence-first crypto buy ratings with heavily weighted tokenomics, holder capture, meme catalysts, early valuation opportunities, and a five-line verdict.

interface.shortDescription: Crypto ratings, tokenomics and current entry strategy
interface.longDescription: Every asset assessment ends with a five-line A/B/C/D/F verdict and entry strategy. Tokenomics carries 35/30/25 points for operating applications, early applications and memes, covering allocation, circulation, dilution, burns, buybacks, dividends and effective holder economics. Memes retain next-week catalysts, a 1-2 month horizon and launchpad checks; early applications retain relative-value expectation entries. Holder-profit, launch-bundle, liquidity and integrity checks remain mandatory.
defaultPrompt: 分析这个 CA：发射台、主池、配对资产、合约权限、团队与风险。
查币股配对是否官方，分红是否真实，并介绍底层股票。
结合当前市值评级：Meme 看未来一周催化、1–2 个月机会和发射台支持；早期应用比较同类估值，评估小仓买预期；最后以五行文本给出评级、赔率和买入策略。
重点核验代币分配、真实流通、解锁增发、销毁/回购/分红比例与实际兑现，说明净稀释和持币收益如何改变当前买入评级。
